explication: OptiScaler is an injected Windows middleware DLL that replaces game upscalers and frame-generation implementations across DirectX 11, DirectX 12, and Vulkan. The principal workflow is: game graphics calls enter API hooks, input adapters translate the game’s selected technology, feature providers dispatch a chosen backend, and GPU resources are produced or presented. Configuration and the in-game overlay control substitutions and tuning. Optional branches add frame generation, HUD correction, low-latency technologies, ASI plugins, and vendor-DLL proxying. The graph reflects sampled files plus capabilities explicitly documented in the README.
